blocks.text: AI-powered wireframes and sitemaps that export to Figma and Webflow

Relume accelerates the earliest phase of web design - sitemap planning and wireframing. Describe your project, and Relume's AI generates a complete sitemap with page hierarchy, then produces wireframes for every page using its library of pre-designed components.

The speed gain is dramatic. What traditionally takes days of planning and wireframing collapses into minutes. And because Relume's components are designed by professionals, the wireframes serve as a strong foundation rather than rough sketches that need complete redesign.

The direct export to Figma and Webflow is what makes Relume practical for real workflows. Generate wireframes, export to Figma for custom design work, or push directly to Webflow for rapid prototyping. The output is production-quality, not throwaway.
Describe your project and get a complete page hierarchy instantly
Generate page wireframes from descriptions using curated components
Thousands of professional wireframe sections organized by type
Push wireframes directly into Figma for detailed design work
Export directly to Webflow for rapid development
Generate typography and color foundations from AI suggestions
Relume cuts the planning phase of web projects from days to minutes. For agencies and freelancers building websites regularly, it fundamentally changes project economics.
Our team can integrate Relume into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
